phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Integrated capacitive soil moisture sensor probe system with embedded microcontroller unit (MCU) and radio communication module designed for real-time wireless soil moisture monitoring in agricultural applications.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This variant represents the industry standard in 2024-2025 as capacitive sensing provides reliable, low-power soil moisture detection, while the embedded MCU enables data processing on the probe. The integrated radio module allows for remote wireless data transmission, which is essential for scalable precision agriculture deployments. These systems are widely adopted due to their accuracy, energy efficiency, and connectivity capabilities.
